description: Election Commission - Elected Mr. E. A. S. Shantha as a Member of the Ambalangoda Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Ambalangoda Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority position, including the nomination and declaration of an elected member to fill a vacancy caused by death, which falls under the Elections classification type.
